observations.why: First-person plural declarative enacts a decisional stance that binds the collective to a single course — authority performed through collective voice.
Proportional performance comparison frames the choice in cost-benefit terms — the relational logic is proportionality, not hierarchy or solidarity.
Commissive voice commits the collective body to a shared timeline — 'the migration' as a we-undertaking, undifferentiated pooling of obligation.
Summary restates the proportional gain in cost-benefit terms, the same market-pricing logic as src-2 compressed into a bullet.
